lines.differs: Worse for AtliQ than CloudSpan Technologies: AtliQ is limited to a 20% revenue share for joint deals regardless of its actual service contribution.
Worse for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: AtliQ receives a 20% revenue share instead of full fixed milestone fees for the services provided.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ only receives a 20% revenue share rather than being paid full invoiced fees on a monthly basis.
Worse for AtliQ than CloudSpan Technologies: lacks specific language protecting AtliQ's ownership of its own methodologies and tools developed during the contract term.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: Datavane retains all platform rights while AtliQ previously owned the intellectual property rights in its work product.
Worse for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: AtliQ grants Datavane a perpetual, irrevocable license instead of retaining ownership and granting a limited license.
Same as Crestline Retail Inc: both provide standard mutual confidentiality protections for non-public information disclosed during the agreement.
Same as Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: both establish standard mutual obligations to keep received information confidential and restrict its disclosure to third parties.
Same as Al Noor Hospitality Group: both clauses include similar mutual definitions and standard protection requirements for confidential business and client information.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: the indemnity is unilateral against AtliQ and covers any breach instead of being mutual and limited to negligence.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: AtliQ provides a broad, unilateral indemnity instead of the mutual intellectual property indemnity previously signed.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: the indemnity is unilateral and applies to any breach rather than being mutual and limited to specific misconduct.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: Datavane's liability is capped at $10,000 while AtliQ's liability for indemnity and confidentiality remains unlimited.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: Datavane has a low $10,000 liability cap whereas the previous contract featured a mutual cap based on fees.
Worse for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: Datavane's liability is capped at $10,000 while AtliQ's liability for indemnity and confidentiality is not capped.
Same as Crestline Retail Inc: changes the governing law and exclusive venue from Ohio to Delaware and San Francisco respectively.
Same as Brightwater Insurance Inc: moves the legal jurisdiction and venue from England and Wales to Delaware and San Francisco.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: lacks the mandatory 30-day good-faith negotiation period required before a party can initiate legal proceedings.
